# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech to Build Something](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting a tech job to pursue entrepreneurial ambitions and self-directed projects.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Orchestrator](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): AI-powered tool orchestrating autonomous software development with Claude, integrating Linear tickets and Git workflows.
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice guide explaining color wheels, dimensions, harmony schemes, and perceptual color spaces for design.
- [History of Martian Ideas](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canals to invasion novels to spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Detailed explanation of sourdough starter microbiology, fermentation chemistry, and baking techniques.
- [The Antikythera Mechanism](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator that predicted eclipses using sophisticated mechanical engineering.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Neuroscience](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through critical periods, auditory feedback, and neural circuits analogous to human speech development.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Why every flat map distorts Earth differently and what trade-offs cartographers must make.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores cold light chemistry, evolutionary adaptations, camouflage strategies, and scientific discoveries in deep-sea organisms.
- [Roman Concrete Durability](https://www.justinhe.com/i): Why Roman concrete structures survive millennia while modern concrete fails faster, examining volcanic ash chemistry and self-healing mechanisms.
